params.val: the same status (Burn, Paralysis, or Poison/Toxic) is also inflicted on whoever caused it
the incoming status is not Burn, Paralysis, Poison, or Toxic

does not reflect Sleep or Freeze, does not trigger from a self-inflicted status (Rest, a status Orb, etc.), and does not trigger when the status came from Toxic Spikes specifically (effect.id === 'toxicspikes' explicitly excluded in source, distinct from an ordinary self-inflicted case)
